tasks.title: Diagnose, repair and verify the suite
tasks.description: The suite has a HermeticByExpectedOutputCount guard that is NOT doing its job because of a wrong configuration key (trap s13#12: unknown keys inside an AssertionConfiguration are silently ignored - no error is raised). In Runner/test.qaas.yaml the guard uses 'ExpectedOutputCount: 1', but the real field name is 'ExpectedCount' (see Fact Base s09). Because 'ExpectedOutputCount' is silently ignored, the guard's expected count is never set and the guard does not actually enforce the output count. Apply the MINIMAL fix to Runner/test.qaas.yaml: rename the key 'ExpectedOutputCount' to 'ExpectedCount' (keep the value 1). Change NOTHING else (no route/port/stub/HttpStatus edits). Write DIAGNOSIS.md citing s13#12 explicitly, then run the e2e verify gate (must be green with the guard now enforcing exactly 1 output).
rubric: Diagnosis identifies the silently-ignored wrong key and cites s13#12

verify.cmd: $m = Start-Process dotnet -ArgumentList 'run','-c','Release','--','run','test.mocker.yaml' -WorkingDirectory '..\Mocker' -PassThru; $ok = $false; foreach ($i in 1..40) { try { (New-Object Net.Sockets.TcpClient('127.0.0.1', 8123)).Close(); $ok = $true; break } catch { Start-Sleep 2 } }; if (-not $ok) { Stop-Process -Id $m.Id -Force; exit 9 }; dotnet run -c Release -- run test.qaas.yaml; $code = $LASTEXITCODE; Stop-Process -Id $m.Id -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; exit $code

acceptanceCriteria: Guard now uses ExpectedCount (the real field)
failureModes: Leaving the wrong key in place
Rewriting the whole file or renaming identifiers

goalOneSentence: Fix a silently-ignored wrong assertion key (ExpectedOutputCount -> ExpectedCount, trap s13#12).
portContract: This sprint's mocker MUST listen on HTTP port 8123. Every runner Transaction MUST target http://127.0.0.1:8123. Do NOT use the 8080 default - use 8123 exactly.
